trades.reasoning: Score 95 with confirmed multi-signal setup (MACD bullish crossover, RSI 63.3 in healthy bullish zone, price 5.7% above SMA-20) and an open slot to fill with idle cash.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ and S&P 500 unchanged) with no fresh news data available, so this wasn't a strong risk-on signal. With 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold, deployed a modest position into HubSpot (HUBS) on solid technical confirmation rather than sitting idle, while holding all 7 existing positions unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: No news data was available today, and both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 were flat, suggesting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major catalyst-driven move. In the absence of macro headlines, today's decision leaned on individual stock technicals rather than broad market sentiment. This kind of low-volatility, data-scarce session is common and doesn't necessarily signal risk ahead.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日未有可用的新聞數據,納指與標普500均持平,顯示市場處於淡靜、缺乏方向的狀態,並非由重大事件驅動。在缺乏宏觀消息的情況下,今日決策主要參考個股技術指標而非整體市場情緒。這種低波動、數據稀缺的交易日相當常見,不一定代表後市有風險。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, using signals like RSI, MACD, and moving averages to confirm the trend is real and not a fluke. Today's HUBS pick relied on three confirming signals (MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above its 20-day average) even though the broader market gave no clear directional cue.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動量投資是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票,並利用RSI、MACD及移動平均線等指標來確認趨勢屬實,而非偶然波動。今日選中HUBS正是基於三個確認訊號(MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於健康區間、股價高於20日均線),即使大市本身並未給出明確方向。
